# Preserve case folding and canonical normalization without silently broadening accent matching

D214781 removed diacritic stripping before landing after Swedish/German distinct-letter feedback. Final/current code normalizes both query and properties and lowercases. A stale Bug attachment comment still says diacritic-insensitive; actual accepted code and review override that comment. Robust accent-insensitive search was deferred, not permanently forbidden. Test/query coverage for further locale policy remains open.

Scope: calendar/base/content.
